mapper.select: SELECT x.zkxmid, x.zkpid, CAST(x.xmid AS UNSIGNED) AS xmid, x.bz, x.bzc, x.zkdz, x.zkgz, x.dx_lx, z.zkpmc FROM zk_nyzkxm x LEFT JOIN sys_zkpd z ON x.zkpid = z.zkpid WHERE 1=1 AND x.zkpid = #{zkpid} ORDER BY x.zkxmid
SELECT xmid FROM zk_nyzkxm WHERE zkxmid = #{zkxmid}
SELECT bz, bzc, zkdz, zkgz, dx_lx FROM zk_nyzkxm WHERE zkxmid = #{zkxmid}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO zk_nyzkxm (zkpid, xmid, bz, bzc, zkdz, zkgz, dx_lx, fhbz) VALUES (#{zkpid}, #{xmid}, #{bz}, #{bzc}, #{zkdz}, #{zkgz}, #{dxLx}, #{fhbz})
mapper.select: SELECT x.zkxmid, x.zkpid, x.xmid, x.bz, x.bzc, j.xmzwmc, x.fhbz as zknd FROM zk_nyzkxm x LEFT JOIN sys_jyxm_full j ON CAST(x.xmid AS UNSIGNED) = j.xmid WHERE x.zkpid = #{zkpid} ORDER BY x.zkxmid
